items.title: TensorFold 1.2.9 adds an Ollama-compatible API and reports 3.2 to 3.5x combined decode on an M5 Ultra
items.summary: TensorFold 1.2.9 adds an Ollama-compatible API, TOML serve configs, better logprobs and fixes for Nemotron image requests and GLM prompt-logprob hangs. On an M5 Ultra, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning MLX 4-bit without an MTP head is reported at 3.2 to 3.5 times combined decode over 24 streams with identical reply tokens in that test.

doubt.pushback: Throughput gain is the maintainer's own single-hardware test; no independent reproduction seen.

items.title: TensorFold PR fits 8 Gemma4 31B streams instead of 4 in the same KV memory on a GB10
items.summary: A pull request to TensorFold keeps less KV per stream on the 31B's long-range layers and rebuilds the rest when needed, doubling streams in the same memory with the same replies. Cold prompts are up to 2.6% slower and the author says to wait for the merge.

doubt.pushback: Opt-in PR not yet merged; the PR itself notes a small decode slowdown in some pairs and says not to land yet.

items.title: Omarchy agents panel adds automatic switching between Claude, Codex and Grok accounts near a usage limit
items.summary: Omarchy's agent tooling can register a second Claude account and switch new sessions to the account with the most room left once usage reaches a set threshold (90% in the example), keeping the current session running. It works for Codex and Grok as well, and the README is in the repo.
